waypoints.name: Rainy Pass / Lake Ann-Maple Pass Trailhead
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 to Rainy Pass at about milepost 157.5 and turn into the Rainy Pass Picnic Site on the south side of the highway. The Lake Ann-Maple Pass trailhead (Trail 740) leaves from the paved lot at about 4,855 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park; day passes are sold at the trailhead.
